description: Asks whether DATE payloads -0.25/0.25, -1.25/-1.5, 0/-0.25, -1.5/-0.5 and two modern times compare equal or ordered, and what subtraction, +1, -1 and CDbl return. Sent as declared DateTime parameters with VT_DATE values, as declared DateTime with VT_R8 values, and as undeclared parameters with VT_DATE and VT_R8 values. A second declared QueryDef asks DateAdd, DateDiff, Hour, Day, DateValue and TimeValue over the same pairs. Payloads are captured as returned. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
